Plan: continue levetiracetam; seizure diary; sleep protection (partner to do a night feed); seizure safety with the baby (bathing, carrying on stairs); neurology review in March. Perinatal mental health: counselling continuing, review GAD-7 in 6 weeks. Iron and ferritin recheck in 3 months. Her daughter is under paediatric review for developmental delay; the family is linked with early intervention. Book a Dari interpreter and a female clinician for every visit.
